name: codex-radar
description: Analyze local Codex collaboration history across 9 dimensions. Deterministic scripts calculate and validate scores; your active Codex session writes an evidence-grounded diagnosis and action plan.

interface.longDescription: Codex Radar reads local Codex session JSONL files, redacts common credentials, and extracts deterministic facts. Your active Codex session writes bounded evidence adjustments and the qualitative diagnosis; bundled scripts calculate every final score, validate the complete report contract, and render a private single-file HTML dashboard. The plugin scripts make no network calls and require no separate API key.
defaultPrompt: Run Codex Radar on this project
